name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The environment says the task is to reach the exit, but neither rule requires `at_exit`; the empty FINAL_STATES confirms there is no hard goal. Add hard Existence(at_exit). The two existing clauses correctly require picking up the box on the step after a fall and holding it when reaching the exit.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires the box to be back in your hands on the next step after it falls. Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires it in your hands when you reach the exit, which is the last step.
